source_policy: Use the professor's monthly series as supplied, including RL. No daily source override, interpolation, return filling, or external data.
eligibility_policy: Both risk estimators use the intersection of their past-only eligibility: 36 consecutive prior monthly observations and membership in the GARCH annual fit with at least 60 observed past months. Signals must also be known.
evaluation_policy: One continuous 1976-2025 account per variant, liquidated only at the final endpoint. Period tables slice the same account; no restart or liquidation at the 2014 boundary.
coverage_policy: After the existing EC/YM exclusions, select a fixed universe with no blanks from each market's first observed return through May 2025. This uses future availability and can have survivorship bias. Test-period results are conditional calendar holdouts, not independently untouched OOS proof.
selection_note: Monthly specification and coverage rules were chosen after the workbook's availability was inspected. All four variants are reported; no winner is automatically promoted.
